Cemetery Home Government Town Clerk Information for Town Clerk A MESSAGE FROM THE TOWN CLERK The Town Clerk’s Office strives to serve Swansea residents in an efficient and friendly manner. The Town Clerk’s Office issues the following items: Birth, Marriage and Death Certificates - certified copies available for $10.00 each Business Certificates - an approval letter is required from the Building Department for first time filers; the fee is $40.00 and the certificate is valid for 4 years. Dog Licenses - Licenses are valid from April 1st of each year to March 31st of the following year.  Licensing applications and instructions are attached to the Annual Town Census and can be applied for when submitting your census form.  Fee:  Spay/Neuter - $10.00 Unaltered - $20.00 Late - $20.00 Recreational Shellfish Permits and Commercial Shellfish Licenses - see the complete fee schedule online. Marriage Intentions/Marriage Licenses - all marriage license applicants need to arrive at least 30 minutes before closing time to complete the application ; Monday to Thursday - must arrive by 4:00PM and Friday - must arrive by 12:30PM. Calling ahead is strongly suggested. Voter Registration - can be done in office, mail in or online: https://www.sec.state.ma.us/divisions/elections/elections-and-voting.htm Street Lists - $10.00 each The Town Clerk's Office also handles the Annual Town Census, Proof of Residency or Voter Status Certificates and Public Records Requests; we accept Zoning applications; are responsible for the posting of all public meetings for Town Boards, Committees and Commissions; and the keeping of all Meeting Minutes. The Town Clerk's Office oversees Town, State and Federal Elections; Annual and Special Town Meetings; and the preservation/archiving of historic documents.  The Town Clerk's Office handles all burial interments for Mount Hope and Vinnicum Woods Cemeteries; and the sale of cemetery lots for both. Staff Contacts: Celine E. Brown , Interim Town Clerk , Assistant Town Clerk Kimberly Botelho , Clerical Assistant Hours of Operation: Monday - Thursday: 8:00am - 4:30pm and Friday: 8:00am - 1:00pm Phone: 508-678-2981 Ext. 4 Celine Brown - #105 Kimberly Botelho - #104 Address: 81 Main Street, Swansea, MA 02777 See map: Google Maps Frequently Asked Questions Quick Links Massachusetts Register to Vote Online Where do I vote? Working farms still adorn main and secondary roadways alike, harkening back to this community's agrarian roots. The Town has a steep history in colonial America, being established in 1667 and incorporated in 1785. The community boasts commercial centers while also provide a plethora of recreational spaces for all abilities.
